items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: So he kept telling me that and finally I did. I didn’t know Branford then so I took his word for it, and he did, he didn’t have, I remember he didn’t have the neck strap, so he was like playing with no neck strap.
